reviews.comment: Professor Junewei has been one of my favorite professors at A&M! That being said, her class is also one of the hardest I have taken at A&M as well. The concepts in this class are challenging, and the class is very test heavy. Be sure to work the practice problems/exams and take time to understand them. She is genuinely so funny and cares so much!

Amazing and funny professor! Her notes are easy to understand and she's really good at teaching the material. The class itself is definitely hard, but if you review the notes once before lecture and go to office hours it really helps. Exams are all FRQ style, but she grades fairly and gives partial credit.

Okay she's actually really funny and I like how organized her class is. The class notes are easy to follow, but her class is HARD. Wish she would actually give practice problems that are going to be on the exams. I walk into the exams confident knowing all the content, and still get bad grades. Don't take her if you want an A.
I personally loved her. Her class is very difficult, but she is a very good professor and makes class fun.

Nice lady but not an organized professor. The notes were very detailed but the problems were easy and "dumbed down." The exams are extremely comprehensive and you are given 2 of them to practice for the tests. There was partial credit for some of the problems and no partial credit for the others. Tests were entirely free-response and bad. RIP me.

Did not prepare us at all for exams. Notes had simple practice problems but difficult comprehensive problems on exams. Practice problems were not at all representative of what would be on the exam and gave us little to no study materials. Would tell us not to worry about certain topics then would put them on the exam. Lots of grey area on exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things
